notes: Employee schedule only; the aggregate for employees earning $75,000 or less is excluded. Job titles are not disclosed in this schedule.
Remuneration includes base salary, retroactive pay, taxable benefits, vacation payouts, retiring allowances, overtime and on-call premiums as defined in the report.
Expenses include travel, tuition, registration fees, relocation allowances and professional membership fees paid to or on behalf of employees.
Blank and dash expense cells are retained as missing, not zero. Negative expense recoveries and the explicitly printed negative zero are retained numerically when present.
Repeated disclosed names remain separate source rows; a name alone is not a unique employee identifier. Estate wording and punctuation are preserved as published.

Displayed named salary amounts sum to $60 more than the printed named subtotal; displayed expenses sum to $114 more. These residuals are compatible with rounding to whole dollars, but the source does not explain them. Individual published amounts are preserved; exact named-subtotal reconciliation is not claimed.
The report states that this schedule is on a cash basis and is not directly reconcilable to accrual-basis financial statements.
The validated employee schedule restores 360 rows absent from the compiled snapshot and preserves one name that the compilation shortened, at the same published pay and expense amounts.
